name: Remixlet
description: Make any site work the way you want. Tell Remixlet what to change, and watch it bend the site to your will.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* data:; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' blob:; worker-src blob:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
